_note: Legacy quest lines (round 119, Robert 2026-10-13): an inheritance is no longer found-and-taken. Touching the seat only opens the master's task; the last step lets you accept. The better the inheritance, the longer the line; the more the master's gift fits your build (tags), the shorter, never below min_share of the base. Steps already met complete themselves. Every number is here; scripts/systems/LegacyLines.gd reads it. Dev rewrites the words.

gather: Bring %d %s as an offering at the master's seat.
The master asks for %d %s -- gather them and keep them ready.
kill: Honour the master's old wars: defeat %d foes on floor %d.
Clear %d of the things that stalk floor %d.
skill: The master's way needs steady hands: reach %s level %d.
reach: Walk down to floor %d. The master wants to know the road is open.
words.done: The master's task is done. Return to the seat and accept the legacy.
